actual.descripcion: Stage Fright | Stephanie is a gifted stage performer and much-loved teacher; behind closed doors, resentment and envy fester in her marriage, leading to a shocking 911 call.

Suspect #1 | After the brutal binding, torture and murder of a woman in her home, her ex-husband calls 911, but police suspect he is the killer. Also, when a man turns up dead in a house fire, his wife tells police he was suicidal, but the truth is even more shocking.

Into the Darkness | In Washington state, an off-duty officer spots a wanted criminal in an elementary school; officers in Georgia chase a woman on a rampage in her car; in Florida, a stolen car crashes, and the suspect flees into an alligator-infested marsh.
